body:
The end-to-end login test fails after the session cookie rename.

## Context

- `e2e/login.spec.ts:12` still reads the old cookie name.

## Requirements

1. The spec reads the new cookie name.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `e2e/login.spec.ts` reads the renamed session cookie.

## Non-goals

- Rewriting the spec.

## Test expectations

- The existing spec.

changes.original: The `UI end-to-end` CI job passes on the PR.

evidence.says: still reads the old cookie name
